name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      contents: write

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - name: Release
        uses: cycjimmy/semantic-release-action@v4

          branch: main
          extra_plugins: |
            @semantic-release/changelog
            @semantic-release/exec
            @semantic-release/git

          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

yaml:
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - name: Release
        uses: cycjimmy/semantic-release-action@v4
        with:
          branch: main
          extra_plugins: |
            @semantic-release/changelog
            @semantic-release/exec
            @semantic-release/git
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
